slots.doc.title: Interviewer Briefing
slots.role.title: Battery Systems Engineer
slots.role.org: Four stages briefed · one debrief form · one decision meeting
slots.doc.thesis: A briefing that repeats the whole interview plan wastes the ten minutes an interviewer actually has. Give each one their own stage, the specific thing to probe, and the two lines they are not allowed to ask.
slots.cover.note: One page per interviewer. Nothing more to read.
slots.s1.title: Your stage, not the whole plan
slots.s1.body: Each interviewer gets the ten-minute version of the plan: what they own, what to probe, and what to review before the candidate joins.
slots.s2.title: What every interviewer holds before the room
slots.s2.body: Stated once here so it never has to be repeated per stage. Read it every time, not only the first time.
slots.caution.1: An interviewer who skips the ten-minute prep window shows up reading the resume live, in front of the candidate. That reads as disorganized and it costs the loop a stage's worth of signal, so protect the window on the calendar.
slots.s3.title: Four fields, the same form every time
slots.s3.body: A rating with no cited evidence is a vibe with a number attached. Every field below asks for the specific thing, never the summary judgment.
slots.s4.title: The decision meeting, in order
slots.s4.body: Thirty minutes, same order every time, so the loudest voice in the room never sets the outcome by going first.
slots.legal.note: Every candidate for this role gets the same stages, the same questions, and the same rubric. A deviation made for one candidate and not another is the fact pattern that turns a rejection into a claim.

prep.stages.prep.focus: Scope fit and ownership appetite. Read the tradeoff lock before the room opens.
The can-they-do-it filter. Bring the two backup questions, not just the primary.
Design depth and a test-rig anomaly. Split ownership before the loop, not during it.
Someone outside the reporting line. Score the scenario, not the resume.

coaching.lines.coach.label: Score the answer, not the accent
coaching.lines.coach.body: A different communication style or a nontraditional path is not a competency gap. Write down the words, not the delivery.

coaching.lines.coach.label: One story is not a pattern
coaching.lines.coach.body: A single strong or weak answer sets that competency's own score, never the rest of the loop. Halo and horn effects are real.

coaching.lines.coach.label: Never ask about protected status
coaching.lines.coach.body: Family plans, age, national origin, disability, and religion stay off the table, directly or by inference from a resume gap.

coaching.lines.coach.label: Write the example, not the adjective
coaching.lines.coach.body: "Strong" is not evidence a debrief can use. The specific thing they said or did is the only entry worth writing down.

debrief.fields.field.label: Technical depth
debrief.fields.field.prompt: Cite the exchange that earned this score. An adjective alone is not a valid entry.

debrief.fields.field.label: Independence
debrief.fields.field.prompt: Name the hint you had to give, or say they reached it alone.

debrief.fields.field.label: Deal-breaker triggered
debrief.fields.field.prompt: Cite the pattern the plan named, or leave this one blank.

debrief.fields.field.label: One line for the room
debrief.fields.field.prompt: The sentence you would say out loud before anyone averages a score.

agenda.items.agenda.title: Scores in before the room opens
agenda.items.agenda.body: No score, no vote. Whoever has not submitted a form does not speak first.

agenda.items.agenda.title: Lowest scorer speaks first
agenda.items.agenda.body: Seniority does not open the meeting. Concerns get air before enthusiasm anchors the room.

agenda.items.agenda.title: Each owner reads their form
agenda.items.agenda.body: Follow the stage order from the interview plan, not seniority or volume.

agenda.items.agenda.title: Decide inside the thirty minutes
agenda.items.agenda.body: Hire, no-hire, or one named missing check with an owner and a date.

handoff.assumptions: Same panel already read the interview plan. No new interviewer added after this briefing goes out.
